newsitem.title: USA: Prime Charter raises cash in model portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Prime Charter raises cash in model portfolio.

text.p: Prime Charter Ltd said on Wednesday it raised cash by 20 percent and reduced stocks and bonds by 10 percent each in the asset allocation of the firm's model portfolio.
Prime Charter Chief Investment Strategist Scott Bleier said the move reflected concern about recent gains in the stock and bond markets.
"We feel that the gains in the bond market have brought yields to fairly valued levels based on general economic conditions and further gains will be minimal," Bleier said.
"As for equities, we feel the activity in the first-tier largest capitalized names have reached frenetic levels, and the narrowness of their advance is cause for near-term concern," he added.
Based on the changes, Prime Charter's model portfolio is allocated with 50 percent in stocks, 20 percent in bonds and 30 percent in cash.
